units.source_text: 这一声呼喊让杜子春醒了过来，

en.t: That cry woke Toshishun from his dream,

units.source_text: 仔细一看，他仍然在夕阳的余晖下沐浴中，

en.t: Looking closely, he was still bathed in the afterglow of the setting sun,

units.source_text: 迷惘的站在洛阳城的西城门下。

en.t: standing in a daze beneath the west gate of Luoyang city.

units.source_text: 云雾缭绕的天空，皎洁的弯月，

en.t: The cloud-veiled sky, the bright crescent moon,

units.source_text: 络绎不绝的行人车马——所有的事情都和他去峨眉山之前一摸一样。

en.t: the endless stream of pedestrians, carts, and horses—everything was exactly as it had been before he went to Mount Emei.
